2034-2317-6763-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

710-2961-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Vizier of Tumbling Sands or Clever Conjurer

1719-2872-7786.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
If Vizier of Tumbling Sands has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
If Clever Conjurer has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.

2395-4508-6428.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
You can cause an artifact to enter under your control.
2395-4508-6428.description:
Cause an artifact to enter under your control.
When the artifact enters, Quicksmith Genius triggers, causing you to rummage.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent that was dealt damage.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Quicksmith Genius triggers that many times.
Resolve a Quicksmith Genius trigger, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 3.

3510-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3510-4772-5702.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

789-1580-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-5223-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6823-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6823-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

772-891-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2440-4460-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4460-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

uses.exileCardState: with a brain counter on it
with a brain counter on it

1247-5536-7221.notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1308-3007-3899-4552.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-1308-3007-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-5970-6219-7014.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
1636-5970-6219-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1558-2963-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five multicolored permanents plus either another multicolored permanent or another creature with power 2 or greater.
1558-2963-6741.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Infinite Guideline Station's station ability by tapping any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater, putting at least twelve charge counters on Infinite Guideline Station, causing it to become a creature.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Robots, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Infinite Guideline Station.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

918-4083-6899.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Donna Noble.
Donna Noble is indestructible.
918-4083-6899.description:
Deal damage to Donna Noble.
Donna Noble and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Donna Noble trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Donna Noble instead of you due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.

539-3045-3293-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-6797.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-6797.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

3525-4289-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-6593-6774.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Loading Zone.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-6593-6774.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

1580-2511-4871-5542.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1339-2034-2122-4029.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-4029.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1812-4222-5390-5516.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
1812-4222-5390-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
1812-4222-5390-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

751-1244-4231-5542.manaNeeded: {1} if the nontoken creature has mana value 3
751-1244-4231-5542.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less.
751-1244-4231-5542.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and another creature with mana value 3 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Cast the other creature by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1744-3487-5770.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating three token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers three times, adding twelve {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating three 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beast tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers three times, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

71-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Mukotai Ambusher does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
71-3489-3542.description:
Declare Mukotai Ambusher as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Mukotai Ambusher from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mukotai Ambusher's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mukotai Ambusher onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

152-2178-4497.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nonlegendary artifact creature with mana value eight or greater.
Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Slobad.
152-2178-4497.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary artifact creature with mana value eight or greater with haste.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature token, adding at least eight {R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
The artifact creature token dies, triggering Slobad, untapping Slobad.
Repeat.

579-2292-2661-4484.notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich had died this turn.
579-2292-2661-4484.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ebondeath, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {2}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.

444-602.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
444-602.description:
During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size.
Feast of Sanity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Feast of Sanity trigger.
Repeat from step 2.

2367-3129-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Repeat.
